title: Accessory detach on death — kinematic scatter with per-kind impulse tuning
notes: Implements GDP-2026-05-27-012 MVP slice via a project-local kinematic system. On BomberStats.alive=false the accessory-detach system finds entities matching `<rootId>.accessoryN.<kind>`, clears their parent (so they stop riding the body), computes a deterministic scatter impulse from DeathImpulse direction + per-kind config (antennae fly up, backpack flies opposite-to-blast, cap straight up with spin, visor falls fast, fins lateral spread), and stamps AccessoryDebris.

Per fixedUpdate the system integrates each AccessoryDebris: position += velocity*dt; vy -= 9.8*dt; rotation += spin*dt; scale shrinks to 0 over the final 300 ms; removeEntity on lifetime expiry (default 1500 ms).

Deferred to a future engine-side follow-up: full Rapier-rigid-body integration through engine/physics/ragdoll/ (RagdollTemplate.accessoryBodies, ACCESSORY_DEBRIS collision group, true rigid-body inertia). The kinematic version reads convincingly at the 1.5 s death-window scale and avoids touching the cross-cutting ragdoll spawn/sync/teardown systems for this sprint.

Live probe with ?suddenDeathTriggerS=3 confirmed: 3 accessory entities present in start scene; after sudden-death kills a bot, AccessoryDetachFired marker stamped on bomber + AccessoryDebris entities mid-flight 2 s later.

stories.title: Accessory-detach system — detect death, scatter impulse, integrate, despawn
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/accessory-detach-system.ts (NEW) — on dead bombers without AccessoryDetachFired, walks `<rootId>.accessoryN.<kind>` ids, computes computeScatterImpulse(blastDir, kindConfig, hash) per accessory, clears Transform.parent, removes SpringPivot + SoftAttached, stamps AccessoryDebris. Integration loop advances every AccessoryDebris entity each tick. computeScatterImpulse + scatterSeedHash exported as deterministic pure helpers.
verification: acceptance: 17 unit tests pass (scatter determinism, blast-east bias direction per kind, dead-bomber spawns debris, alive bomber skipped, AccessoryDetachFired prevents re-fire, parent cleared, position integration, gravity reduces vy, lifetime despawn, non-matching ids skipped, SpringPivot + SoftAttached removed).
